args.title: Re-enable ExportButton on export failure
args.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

Add a .catch() handler or use try/finally to call setBusy(false) even when exportReport fails, ensuring the button is re-enabled.

label: bug
file: src/components/ExportButton.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

ExportButton uses .then() without .catch(), so if exportReport rejects, setBusy(false) is never called and busy stays true. Add a .catch() handler or use try/finally to call setBusy(false) even when exportReport fails.

args.title: Update README.md to use npm start instead of npm run serve
args.body:
File: README.md

Update the instructions in README.md to replace `npm run serve` with `npm start` to match the scripts defined in package.json.

args.title: Strip trailing carriage returns in src/ingest/parser.ts
args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

Strip any trailing carriage return (\r) from each line during CSV parsing in parseStatement to correctly handle Windows-style line endings (\r\n) and prevent field count mismatches.

label: docs
file: README.md
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The README.md instructions currently tell users to run `npm run serve`, but package.json defines `start` instead of `serve`. We will update README.md to use `npm start` so users follow the correct command.

label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The `parseStatement` function splits input strictly by `\n`, causing Windows-style line endings (`\r\n`) to leave a trailing `\r` on every line. This results in field count mismatches against the header lengths, which can be fixed by stripping any trailing carriage return (`\r`) from each line during parsing.

File: src/exportUtils.ts

Add 'tsv' to SUPPORTED_FORMATS, update CONTENT_TYPES, implement TSV export logic, and handle 'tsv' in renderExport and report schedules.
args.title: Add TSV export format support

args.body:
label: feature
file: src/exportUtils.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The export utilities currently only support csv and xlsx formats, limiting reporting options. Adding 'tsv' support to `SUPPORTED_FORMATS`, `CONTENT_TYPES`, export rendering, and report schedules will enable TSV exports.
